values.meaning: bonus magic damage dealt when the third stack of Resonance is consumed

values.quote: apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Resonance'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds
values.binNote: No bin row carries this duration; EkkoPassive.LockoutTime=4 is the same numeric value but is the separate per-target retrigger lockout (p_4), not this stack-refresh window. No dedicated stack-duration field exists in the sheet.
The sheet has no explicit stack-cap field; the value 3 is implied only by EkkoPassive#ThreeHitDamage being the 'third hit' damage calculation, not stated as a standalone data value.

values.meaning: per-target cooldown before Resonance can trigger again on the same target

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks on-hit and damaging abilities apply a stack of Resonance to enemies hit; the third stack consumes all stacks to deal bonus magic damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Ekko's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Resonance'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times.

mechanics.claim: Resonance stacks are not applied nor consumed if the basic attack is dodged, blocked, or misses.
mechanics.quote: ''Resonance'' stacks will not be applied nor consumed if the basic attack is {{tip|dodged}} or {{tip|blocked}} or if the attack {{tip|blind|misses}}.

mechanics.claim: Z-Drive Resonance deals 270% damage against monsters, not champions, so it does not apply in a champion dummy fight.
Triggering Resonance against a champion grants Ekko bonus movement speed, not relevant to damage dealt or taken.
mechanics.quote: Triggering ''Resonance'' against a {{tip|champion}} grants '''Ekko''' {{pp|key=%|50 to 80 for 4|1 to 16|color=movement speed}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}
